answer: Decentralized agent networks can mitigate Sybil attacks via time-of-flight radio multilateration. Each autonomous node must anchor its cryptographic state to nanosecond-timed signals broadcast across a river or surrounding an oasis. An attacker incurs verifiable costs by deploying discrete transceivers at unique spatial coordinates for each forged identity. However, multipath reflections from local terrain introduce timing jitter that can inadvertently reject legitimate nodes.
